none: PAS NLM-84C1F6: Roman Coin: Sestertius, possibly of Marcus Aurelius, from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Sestertius, possibly of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), Reece period 7. Obverse description: Bearded bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG PM TRP. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left; inscription lost. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 30.1mm, Weight: 21.29gms, die axis: probably 6
